# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/gendocs from internal/config/config.go. Do not edit by hand. -->

`config.yaml` holds process-level settings only. Users, categories and assets live in the
database. `lanventory config init` writes an example and creates `secret.key`; the same file is
[config.example.yaml](config.example.yaml). The file is found with `-c/--config`, else
`LANVENTORY_CONFIG`, else `/etc/lanventory/config.yaml`.

- Relative paths are relative to the directory of the configuration file.
- Unknown keys are ignored. For editor validation, point your YAML language server at
  [config.schema.json](config.schema.json).
- Changes take effect after a restart.
- Environment variables override: `LANVENTORY_LISTEN` (`listen`), `LANVENTORY_PUBLIC_URL`
  (`public_url`) and `LANVENTORY_LOG_LEVEL` (`log.level`).

Command line: `lanventory server`, `config init [--force]`, `migrate`, `backup [file]`, `user create|passwd|list|delete`, `version`.
Passwords are read from the terminal, or from stdin when piped (one line), and need at least 10
characters. `backup` writes a consistent copy with `VACUUM INTO` while the server runs.

## Top level

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `listen` | string | `127.0.0.1:9060` | The HTTP listen address, e.g. "127.0.0.1:9060". |
| `public_url` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:9060` | The externally visible base URL (scheme, host and port, no path). If it starts with https://, session cookies are marked Secure. Requests whose Origin header differs from it are rejected. |
| `trusted_proxies` | []string | `[127.0.0.1, ::1]` | The proxy IPs or networks whose X-Real-IP / X-Forwarded-For headers are trusted for client IPs (lockout, audit log). |
| `secret_key_file` | string | `secret.key` | The file with the AES-256 key that encrypts secrets in the database (64 hex characters). It is created if missing. |

## `storage` – Configures the SQLite database

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storage.path` | string | `data/lanventory.db` | The SQLite database file. Its directory is created if missing. |

## `log` – Configures logging

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `log.level` | string | `info` | The minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error. Allowed: `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. |
| `log.format` | string | `text` | The log output format: text or json. Allowed: `text`, `json`. |

## `tls` – Enables the built-in TLS listener; usually a reverse proxy does this

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tls.cert_file` | string | `–` | The PEM certificate (chain). Set together with tls.key_file. |
| `tls.key_file` | string | `–` | The PEM private key. |

## `inventory` – Configures inventory behavior (number format of generated inventory numbers)

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inventory.number_format` | string | `{prefix}-{seq:05}` | The template of automatically assigned inventory numbers: {prefix} is the category prefix, {seq:05} the running number with the given minimum width. Without {prefix} (for example "{seq:04}" for 0001, 0002, …) all categories share one running number; a category without prefix drops {prefix} and the separator after it. |

## `organization` – Describes who runs this instance; it appears on printed inspection protocols

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organization.name` | string | `–` | Printed in the header of inspection protocols, for example the name of your association or company. Optional; empty prints no name. |

## `api` – Configures the REST API under /api/v1

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api.rate_limit` | float | `10` | The sustained number of API requests per second for each API token (browser sessions are limited per user). Excess requests get HTTP 429. |
| `api.rate_burst` | int | `30` | The number of API requests a token may send at once before RateLimit applies. |
